jobs.title: INTESCIA - DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) - Stage MASTER II (6 mois)
jobs.location: CARQUEFOU, Pays de la Loire, France France
jobs.jd: DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Contexte du stage Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ». Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place. Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie. Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe. Votre mission : L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées. Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse. Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus. Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont : • Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore • Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise • Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail. Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel. Informations importantes ð Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ; ð Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia. Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs. Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty. Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec. • Les étapes du recrutement seront les suivantes : 1er entretien avec Julie QUEIROS , DATA SCIENTIST chez Explore, accompagnée du personnel encadrant du laboratoire ; 2ème entretien et restitution de cas pratique avec Julie, accompagnée de son N+1 Steven HELLEC, ainsi que des encadrants du laboratoire ; 3ème et dernier entretien avec l’équipe RH, pour tout formaliser. Le profil que nous recherchons Étudiant·e de Master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Informatique / Mathématiques Information / Statistiques / Traitement du langage naturel / Data Science. Appétence à la recherche Connaissances en : Python, SQL, Méthodes de NLP Maîtrise de l’anglais Qualités de rédaction, d’analyse et d’autonomie appréciées. You are a dynamic individual who can build and seamlessly integrate AI solutions across the full stack, driving forward our AI initiatives and ensuring robust, scalable implementations. jobs.jd: About Us_ // At Masabi , we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ // We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help build the AI capabilities that will live inside Justride, the platform behind fare collection for transit agencies around the world. This is a 12-month contractor role , with potential for extension. Justride holds the fares, rules and ticketing data that keep public transport moving. You'll help turn that into AI features that riders and agency teams can trust, especially where getting the answer right really matters. This is a hands-on role across the full stack. You'll build the services and the interfaces agency teams use, including new experiences in Justride Hub, our back-office platform for agencies. You'll take features from idea to production, help shape how we test, release and run AI safely, and share what you learn so engineers across Masabi can build with AI with confidence. You'll join a small, growing AI team at an exciting moment, with plenty of room to shape how things are done. We work on early proofs of concept as well as production features, often without detailed tickets, so you'll shape the work as much as deliver it. Location_ // This is a fully remote contract role for candidates based in Romania Responsibilities_ Design and build AI agents and features end to end, from model integration and backend services through to the interfaces people use Build the frontend for our AI features, so agency teams get experiences that feel clear and easy to trust Connect Justride with the AI tools riders and agency teams already use, in a safe and reliable way Set up testing, evaluation and monitoring, so we understand how AI features behave before and after release Make thoughtful choices on models, prompting, retrieval and tool use, balancing quality, speed and cost Make sure AI features use our platform's rules and data accurately wherever precision matters Partner with product and design colleagues to turn early ideas and proofs of concept into production products Help shape good practice for building with AI across engineering, through reviews, guidance and pairing Contribute to security and privacy reviews for features that handle rider and payment data About You_ A track record of taking AI agents or LLM-based features into production, where real users rely on them Someone who takes initiative and is at ease with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined problem from proof of concept to production A strong full-stack background, including frontend (TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue) and backend (ideally Python), ready to own the Justride Hub UI and use AI coding tools with good judgement Hands-on experience with retrieval, tool use or agent frameworks, and a good sense of where they fall short Practical experience evaluating and monitoring AI systems, and using what you learn to improve them Confidence working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and modern engineering practices Generous with your knowledge and keen to help the engineers around you grow A clear communicator when explaining technical ideas to people with different backgrounds If you've done work like this but don't match every line, we'd still love to hear from you Nice To Have_ Experience building integrations for AI assistants or agent platforms, such as MCP Experience working with payments or other regulated data Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) Kotlin or Java backend experience Experience with distributed systems and microservices Experience in transit, ticketing or B2B SaaS Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all. // We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work. Whoever you are, just be yourself. // We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions. Why Join Masabi? Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are. Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey. Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load. We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist 5 (L5) - Human Understanding & Applied AI, Content &
jobs.jd: At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. Netflix is the world’s leading streaming entertainment service with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries, enjoying series, documentaries, feature films, and live events across a wide variety of genres and languages. The Content Data Science and Engineering (DSE) team is passionate about storytelling and bringing our members joy. The Role Our mission at Netflix is to entertain the world; understanding our members’ experiences is an important part of that mission. This role focuses on creating data solutions that support our entertainment partners as they shape our strategy. We are a highly collaborative team that partners across Netflix to drive impact. As a Machine Learning Scientist on Netflix Preview Club, you will develop the innovation that supports our creative teams as they shape the future of television, movies, and more. What You'll Do: Develop statistical and psychometric models, with sampling, weighting and benchmarking methods, that make audience measurements comparable across screenings, titles and time points. Build and evaluate AI-assisted and agentic analysis tools, including methods for measuring their reliability. Develop measurement for early stages of the content lifecycle, such as concepts, pitches and scripts, and link it through pre-release screenings to on-service performance. Develop and validate new methods of collecting audience data. Take methods from prototype to production with engineering, as tools that researchers and analysts use directly. Partner with consumer insights researchers, content teams, data scientists, and engineers to define high-impact measurement problems and drive key decisions. What We're Looking For: We don't expect any one candidate to have everything on this list. If you have a partial fit, we encourage you to apply. Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Cognitive Science, or a related quantitative field, or a Master's degree combined with extensive relevant experience. Strong statistical knowledge and intuition, including Bayesian and psychometric models of human judgment, and good judgment about when a causal approach is required. Experience working with survey data, including survey sampling and weighting. A track record of building and productizing models or measurement systems, with a systems approach from prototype through production. Strong programming skills in Python or R, and strong SQL. Ability to turn ambiguous problems into practical solutions, and to communicate technical concepts clearly to audiences at many levels of technical depth. Experience with any of: qualitative research methods; LLM-based or agentic analysis tools; media and entertainment, user research, or human-evaluation data. Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including intellectual curiosity and humility. Enthusiastic about Netflix culture. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $500,000.00 - $860,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here. Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Master Thesis on Robust Agentic HEMS Control using Time-Series Foundation Models via MCP
jobs.jd: Modern Home Energy Management Systems (HEMS) face the challenge of translating complex user requests into concrete, dependable system actions. While state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) are advancing rapidly in reasoning, multi-modal comprehension, and tool usage, high-precision quantitative modeling of physical signals remains computationally demanding. Specialized Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) offer compelling complementary capabilities for modeling complex numerical curve dynamics, opening up exciting opportunities to explore where and how TSFMs can most effectively support LLM-driven agents. In this Master's thesis, you will research a robust, closed-loop agentic framework where an LLM agent interacts with specialized time-series foundation models via the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) to analyze, safeguard, and optimize HEMS operations. The thesis can emphasize one or more of the following research directions: Closed-Loop Control & Dynamic Forecasting: Interactive feedback loops for iterative parameter optimization and trajectory simulation. Anomaly Detection & System Guardrails: Real-time identification of abnormal consumption, device faults, and operational constraints. Data Quality & Smart Imputation: Generative zero-shot reconstruction of missing sensor time-series to ensure dependable downstream operation. During your 6-month thesis, your work will focus on the following key areas: During your assignment, you will connect a specialized Time-Series Foundation Model (TSFM) as an independent service to an existing LLM agent ecosystem using the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will investigate how numerical time-series outputs generated by the TSFM (predictions, reconstructed values, anomaly scores) can be mathematically abstracted at the server level into concise semantic representations tailored for LLM reasoning. Additionally, you will design an interactive evaluation loop where the agent proposes parameter actions, evaluates the model's simulated response or safety feedback, and converges on optimal, robust control decisions. Finally, you will systematically evaluate scenarios and data representations to determine where specialized TSFMs deliver measurable advantages over pure LLM reasoning in terms of computational efficiency, token consumption, latency, and predictive accuracy. Education: master studies in the field of Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or comparable with good grades Experience and Knowledge: strong proficiency in Python (especially familiarity with data and time-series processing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, as well as modern asynchronous frameworks like asyncio); theoretical and practical grounding in machine learning (ideally time-series models / foundation models); solid understanding of modular software architectures and network interfaces Personality and Working Practice: you are highly self-motivated, using your strong analytical skills to drive independent scientific research Work Routine: we offer you the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup Enthusiasm: strong interest in agentic workflows, tool-calling mechanisms and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Language: very good in English or German Start: according to prior agreement Duration: 6 months Requirement for this thesis is the enrollment at university. Please attach your CV, transcript of records, examination regulations and if indicated a valid work and residence permit. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Alliance (all genders)
jobs.jd:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech-a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization, pricing, and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role, you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several high-impact machine learning domains are actively hiring, and your project and team placement will be aligned based on your individual strengths, interests, and expertise during the interview process. Key domains include:

  • Risk, Fraud & Payments (Growth Alliance): You will own production ML systems that protect HelloFresh from checkout fraud and intelligently recover failed recurring payments (such as Smart Payment Retry) via low-latency scoring on Databricks.
  • Personalization & Conversions (Growth Alliance): You will build real-time decisioning systems, customer win-back models, and scalable GenAI content pipelines that tailor journeys and messaging across visitor and customer funnels.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Customer Value Optimization (Growth Alliance): You will architect and scale the core Pricing Engine to drive pricing optimization and forecasting across 8 brands, 34 markets, and all weekly menus.

Across all domains, you will work on scalable, high-availability production ML systems serving global architectures. Please note that this is an individual contributor role and does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh, we are moving away from a model where engineers simply execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. As a Product Engineer, you will take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

  • Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.
  • Architect and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark on Databricks, Kafka), feature stores, and low-latency serving infrastructure.
  • Improve inference performance, reliability, and compute cost by profiling bottlenecks, right-sizing infrastructure, and maintaining tight latency targets with dependable fallback mechanisms.
  • Establish and raise modern MLOps standards across teams, including CI/CD automation, model registry versioning, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automated validation gates, and drift detection.
  • Design and execute rigorous experimentation frameworks from A/B tests and holdouts to off-policy evaluation-to credibly measure model impact on core business metrics.
  • Build and scale domain-specific applied AI solutions, ranging from real-time scoring and contextual bandits to production GenAI pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to pressure-test models for production readiness, mentor teammates, and leverage AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to accelerate engineering delivery.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

  • 5+ years building and operating live ML systems in production, paired with the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.
  • Hands-on experience building product-facing ML solutions directly tied to measurable business metrics (such as conversion, retention, revenue, or risk reduction).
  • Deep command of Python, SQL, and large-scale data processing (PySpark on Databricks), paired with solid software engineering practices (testing, clean code, version control) and familiarity with low-latency serving or backend languages like Go.
  • Hands-on background with cloud environments (AWS), containerization, automated CI/CD, and modern ML or orchestration tooling such as Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, or Terraform.
  • Practical, day-to-day fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) beyond casual experimentation—knowing how to structure context and set clear boundaries on AI-generated work.
  • A quality-first mindset around model evaluation, drift monitoring, and A/B testing pitfalls for ML systems to ensure bad data or outputs never reach customers.
  • A bias to ship ("finishing the last twenty percent"), strong product sense backed by data, and clear communication skills across international, multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

  • A track record of optimizing data and ML pipelines for performance and cost at scale.
  • Experience with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production LLM pipelines.
  • Background in churn prediction and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
  • Prior experience in high-growth consumer tech or subscription-based businesses.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, AWS Infrastructure Services Science
jobs.jd: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. AWS Infrastructure Services Science (AISS) researches and builds machine learning models that influence the power utilization at our data centers to ensure the health of our thermal and electrical infrastructure at high infrastructure utilization. As a Data Scientist, you will work on our Science team and partner closely with other scientists and data engineers as well as Business Intelligence, Technical Program Management, and Software teams to accurately model and optimize our power infrastructure. Outputs from your models will directly influence our data center topology and will drive exceptional cost savings. You will be responsible for building data science prototypes that optimize our power and thermal infrastructure, working across AWS to solve data mapping and quality issues (e.g. predicting when we might have bad sensor readings), and contribute to our Science team vision. You are skeptical. When someone gives you a data source, you pepper them with questions about sampling biases, accuracy, and coverage. When you’re told a model can make assumptions, you actively try to break those assumptions. You have passion for excellence. The wrong choice of data could cost the business dearly. You maintain rigorous standards and take ownership of the outcome of your data pipelines and code. You do whatever it takes to add value. You don’t care whether you’re building complex ML models, writing blazing fast code, integrating multiple disparate data-sets, or creating baseline models - you care passionately about stakeholders and know that as a curator of data insight you can unlock massive cost savings and preserve customer availability. You have a limitless curiosity. You constantly ask questions about the technologies and approaches we are taking and are constantly learning about industry best practices you can bring to our team. You have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with product owners to understand key business questions and earn the trust of senior leaders. You will need to learn Data Center architecture and components of electrical engineering to build your models. You are comfortable juggling competing priorities and handling ambiguity. You thrive in an agile and fast-paced environment on highly visible projects and initiatives. The tradeoffs of cost savings and customer availability are constantly up for debate among senior leadership - you will help drive this conversation. jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. What You Will Be Doing: Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers. What We Need To See: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows. Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming. Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows. Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. jobs.jd:
DECATHLON DIGITAL 

L'entité Data de Decathlon coordonne l'ensemble des activités visant à l'accélération et la généralisation de l'usage et la valorisation des données.

Decathlon vise à devenir la meilleure plateforme digitale de sport et l'écosystème ouvert le plus performant au monde. Nous voulons permettre à nos clients de vivre l'expérience Decathlon à travers de nombreuses expériences locales centrées sur le sport en connectant de nombreux acteurs et services tiers, de manière sécurisée et performante.

Nos équipes digitales à Lille, Paris et Nantes - qui rassemblent plus de 5000 collaborateurs - sont unies pour construire et faire évoluer des produits digitaux avec l'objectif de toujours offrir la meilleure valeur à nos utilisateurs. Présent dans plus de 70 pays, Decathlon est engagé dans l'innovation, la durabilité et la satisfaction des clients.

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Computer Vision pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, l'analyse visuelle en magasin représente un levier majeur pour optimiser l'excellence opérationnelle et mieux comprendre l'expérience client.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de concevoir et prototyper des solutions innovantes basées sur la vision par ordinateur en exploitant différents flux visuels (images et vidéos), dans le strict respect des normes de confidentialité (RGPD).

L'enjeu : allier recherche algorithmique de pointe et impact concret sur le terrain, à travers des cas d'usage variés tels que l'analyse automatisée des rayons (détection de ruptures, conformité de mise en rayon) et la compréhension des parcours en magasin (estimation de pose, cartes de chaleur).

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la démonstration de valeur :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les dernières approches en Computer Vision (détection d'objets, segmentation, estimation de pose, modèles de fondation visuels).
  • Détection et analyse de rayons : Développer des algorithmes de détection d'objets, de segmentation et de classification pour analyser les photos de linéaires (identification d'articles, détection de ruptures visuelles, conformité de mise en rayon et supports de communication).
  • Analyse de flux et estimation de pose : Prototyper des modèles d'estimation de pose pour modéliser les dynamiques et parcours en magasin, tout en garantissant le strict respect du RGPD.
  • Exploration de données et entraînement : Préparer des jeux de données complexes (images et vidéos) et entraîner ou adapter des modèles de l'état de l'art (ex. YOLO, ViT, modèles de fondation, MediaPipe).
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes avancées et résultats à travers des visualisations et des démonstrations (PoC) auprès des équipes techniques et métiers.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, OpenCV, modèles & librairies de Computer Vision (ex. YOLO, ViT, Foundation Models, MediaPipe)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Computer Vision, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en Machine Learning, Deep Learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) et Computer Vision (ex. OpenCV, YOLO, ViT).
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes d'images/vidéos en environnement réel.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

jobs.jd: If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. About the Role We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. - Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. - Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. - Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, User Simulation and Advanced Synthetic Data Generation
jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, TX, Remote US, PA, Remote US, WA, Remote US, CA, Remote US, MA, Remote
jobs.jd: Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our new User Simulation and Advanced Synthetic Data Generation team. You will own the systems our research runs on: the architecture, scale, and releases of our open-source framework. You'll also build the environments where simulated users meet models and agents. User simulation is quickly becoming core infrastructure for evaluating and training AI models and agents. They are judged by how they work with users, people or other agents, over many turns: holding a conversation, using tools, or collaborating on code in a real repository. Real data is thinnest here: slow and costly to collect, skewed toward existing users, and missing the long tail of languages, domains, and safety scenarios. We build grounded synthetic users and simulators, then use both to find capability gaps and close them with targeted training data and RL environments. A lot of our work ships as open source, including NeMo User Sim, Nemotron-Personas, and the data and environments we generate. We build our own systems on these same tools. We publish and present at top conferences, and we organize UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026, the first NeurIPS workshop on user simulation. The team serves three groups: Internal partners , including Nemotron and other model, agent, and product teams who evaluate and train their models with our simulators. Open-source users and contributors who build on the framework for their own models, agents, and languages. The research community , through work that pushes the state of the art and is published at top venues. The mission is the boss. We organize around the problem, not titles or ownership. Researchers write production code, engineers shape research, and everyone works directly with partner teams. We share credit, review each other's work candidly, and pick up whatever moves the mission forward. What you'll be doing: Own the architecture of NeMo User Sim: the conversation engine, configuration-driven pipelines, and extension API. Scale simulation to tens of thousands of concurrent multi-turn episodes against hosted and self-served models (e.g., vLLM, NIM), sharded across Slurm or Kubernetes. Runs must survive rate limits and partial failures, resume cleanly, and reproduce down to the row. Build and run environments for agents. These include stateful simulated tool services, and sandboxed coding environments where simulated users work with coding agents on real repositories. Verifiers and hidden tests grade the results. Connect simulated users to NeMo Gym and RL training, and keep the loop fast and cheap. Turn research prototypes into reliable, tested features together with research scientists. Run the open-source project: versioned releases, CI/CD, dependency and license hygiene, issue triage, and contributor reviews. Build the pipelines behind our open data releases, onboard internal partner teams, and present the framework at conferences. What we need to see: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 6+ years building production ML systems, data pipelines, or developer libraries. Expert Python skills, with a track record of typed, tested libraries that other teams depend on. Experience running LLM workloads at scale: serving (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, NIM), concurrency, and cost. Experience with LLM evaluation, training-data pipelines, or agents that use tools. Strong software design judgment on interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility, with the mission ahead of ownership and credit. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Maintaining a widely used open-source ML library. RL training infrastructure or environments, such as NeMo Gym or NeMo RL. Infrastructure for coding agents: container sandboxes and SWE-bench-style harnesses. Inference optimization: distillation, quantization, or speculative decoding. Experience with NeMo Data Designer, Ray, or Spark and experience with multilingual text processing, such as language identification, scripts, and localization. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, and you want to build the open-source infrastructure behind trustworthy user simulation, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Product Owner für Agentic-Twin-Plattform explore (m/w/d)
jobs.jd: Pfaffenhofen a. d. Ilm • Vollzeit • ab sofort Wir sind EXP Software GmbH: Wir sind ein Team aus rund 25 Softwareentwickler*innen mit Herz, Humor und Leidenschaft für Technologie. Wir bauen explore, eine Agentic-Twin-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, komplexe Prozesse durch autonome KI-Agenten abzubilden und zu automatisieren.Unser Produkt wächst und damit auch die Anforderungen an jemanden, der den Überblick behält: zwischen dem, was Kunden brauchen, was die Geschäftsführung vorhat, und dem, was das Entwicklungsteam realistisch umsetzen kann. Genau diese Brücke baust du. Wir suchen keinen Prozess-Verwalter, der Tickets schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der explore wirklich versteht, sich für das Produkt begeistert und mit Klarheit und Konsequenz dafür sorgt, dass die richtigen Dinge in der richtigen Reihenfolge gebaut werden. Aufgaben Produktvision & Roadmap Du erstellst und verantwortest das Product Backlog für explore: Pflege, Priorisierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Kunden und Entwicklungsteam. Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele und Kundenanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, und das präzise genug für das Team und verständlich genug für alle anderen. Du setzt klare Prioritäten und begründest sie: Was bauen wir als nächstes – und warum? Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine mittelfristige Produkt-Roadmap und hältst sie am Leben. Du durchdringst die explore-Plattform inhaltlich: Agentenlogik, Automatisierungskonzepte, Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und bringst Impulse aus dem KI-Markt direkt ins Produkt. Team & Wissenstransfer Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit Bestandskunden, verstehst ihre Arbeitsprozesse und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich wichtig sind und welche nur laut. Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback, Support-Erkenntnisse und Marktbeobachtungen in konkrete Produktentscheidungen. Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eingehende Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht, alles bewertet wird und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar sind. Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner eigenen Arbeit: zur Recherche, Dokumentation, Analyse, Priorisierung und Automatisierung. Zusammenarbeit & Steuerung Du arbeitest täglich eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern zusammen: Sprint Planning, Refinements, Reviews; du bist dabei und bringst dich inhaltlich ein. Du beantwortest Rückfragen des Teams schnell und verbindlich, nimmst Ergebnisse ab und stellst sicher, dass sie den definierten Akzeptanzkriterien entsprechen. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge gut genug, um sinnvolle Abwägungen zwischen Aufwand und Nutzen zu treffen. Du planst Demos vor Kunden und Stakeholdern und führst diese direkt im Produkt auch selbst aus. Qualifikation Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Tech-Umfeld und weißt, wie agile Produktentwicklung in der Praxis funktioniert. Eine Zertifizierung als Product Owner ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss. Du hast ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklung und KI-Konzepten. Ein Informatikstudium oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend. Entscheidend ist, dass du mit dem Entwicklungsteam auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren kannst. Du verstehst, wie LLMs, Agenten und Automatisierungssysteme funktionieren; nicht zwingend auf Code-Ebene, aber konzeptionell sicher genug, um Produktentscheidungen darauf zu gründen. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer, LPX
jobs.jd: We are now looking for a Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer! NVIDIA is seeking engineers to develop algorithms and optimizations for our LPX inference and compiler stack. You will work at the intersection of large-scale systems, compilers, and deep learning, crafting how neural network workloads map onto future NVIDIA platforms. This is your chance to be part of something outstandingly innovative! What you’ll be doing: Build, develop, and maintain high-performance runtime and compiler components, focusing on end-to-end inference optimization. Define and implement mappings of large-scale inference workloads onto NVIDIA’s systems. Extend and integrate with NVIDIA’s SW ecosystem, contributing to libraries, tooling, and interfaces that enable seamless deployment of models across platforms. Benchmark, profile, and monitor key performance and efficiency metrics to ensure the compiler generates efficient mappings of neural network graphs to our inference hardware. Collaborate closely with hardware architects and design teams to feedback software observations, influence future architectures, and codesign features that unlock new performance and efficiency points. Prototype and evaluate new compilation and runtime techniques, including graph transformations, scheduling strategies, and memory/layout optimizations tailored to spatial processors. Publish and present technical work on novel compilation approaches for inference and related spatial accelerators at top tier ML, compiler, and computer architecture venues. What we need to see: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience, with 5 years of relevant experience. Strong software engineering background with proficiency in systems level programming (e.g., C/C++ and/or Rust) and solid CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and concurrency. Hands on experience with compiler or runtime development, including IR design, optimization passes, or code generation. Experience with LLVM and/or MLIR, including building custom passes, dialects, or integrations. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch, and experience working with portable graph formats such as ONNX. Solid understanding of parallel and heterogeneous compute architectures, such as GPUs, spatial accelerators, or other domain specific processors. Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience using profiling, tracing, and benchmarking tools to drive performance improvements. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across hardware, systems, and software teams. Ideal candidates will have direct experience with MLIR based compilers or other multilevel IR stacks, especially in the context of graph based deep learning workloads. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Prior work on spatial or dataflow architectures, including static scheduling, pipeline parallelism, or tensor parallelism at scale. Contributions to opensource ML frameworks, compilers, or runtime systems, particularly in areas related to performance or scalability. Demonstrated research impact, such as publications or presentations at conferences like PLDI, CGO, ASPLOS, ISCA, MICRO, MLSys, NeurIPS, or similar. Experience with large-scale AI distributed inference or training systems, including performance modeling and capacity planning for multi rack deployments. #LI-Hybrid Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. In this role, you will work closely with our product, design, and backend teams to build and enhance our generative AI platform. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our product and contribute to a culture of innovation and excellence. Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. jobs.jd: Build the Path Forward At Path Robotics , we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers. What You'll Do Frame open-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well-defined ML problems. Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. Active perception, next-best-view or informative path planning, or 3D point cloud learning. Uncertainty estimation and calibration, or Bayesian and information-theoretic planning. GPU inference optimization (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX). Simulation and sim-to-real transfer (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). Publications at RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or similar venues. Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction. Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain. You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do : Insights about Outsight Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience. We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports. Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW. Context We are looking for a pioneering backend developer to engineer the intelligence engine of our spatial workflows. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.

This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged; it’s finished when the system flies.

You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench.

No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling.
  • Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end.
  • Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it.
  • Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations.
  • Work on site with partners and customers to run flight tests, trials and demonstrations, solving problems directly in the field.
  • Deploy software releases to customer systems, including flashing, configuration and calibration.
  • Report field learnings back to core engineering in a form they can act on, and help shape the product roadmap with real customer input.
  • Document what you build so that future teams can repeat it.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Robotics or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Solid experience developing software in modern C++, plus Python for tooling, automation and data analysis
  • Strong Linux skills, including the command line, logs, Docker and networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Experience getting software running on embedded or physical systems, including comfort with UART, CAN, I2C and SPI, wiring, and using a multimeter on the bench
  • A structured approach to debugging and the ability to stay methodical under time pressure
  • Clear communication in English with customers, operators and engineers alike
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink or QGroundControl
  • Experience with video pipelines, computer vision, or radio and datalink systems
  • Integration or field engineering experience in automotive, robotics or aerospace
  • Experience working with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership 

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Sr Applied Scientist, Embedded Battery Algorithms, Energy Storage
jobs.jd: Do you want to write the algorithms that control next-generation batteries, and shape the future of energy storage? This role sits where electrochemistry, data/ML, and control theory meet. You will develop the physics-informed and data-driven methods that estimate state of charge, health, power capability, and remaining life, and validate them against lab and fleet data until they are ready to ship. Your algorithms will decide how hard a battery can be pushed, when it needs attention, and how long it will last, so they shape the safety, warranty, and economics of the whole product. You will work side by side with cell, systems, and software engineers, and as an early hire you will help define how we develop and validate battery algorithms. This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic and international travel, up to 10% of the time. Key job responsibilities - Develop and own algorithms for state of charge, state of health, power capability, and remaining useful life, combining physics-based models with data-driven and estimation methods. - Deliver validated reference implementations, test vectors, and accuracy targets that define what production code must achieve. - Design the test plans and data needed to develop and validate algorithms, working with the cell and testing teams to turn lab and field data into model improvements. - Analyze algorithm performance across the deployed fleet, find where models drift or fail, and drive improvements. - Own the accuracy and robustness of battery algorithms, and sign off that production implementations match the validated reference. Provide algorithm evidence for safety certification. A day in the life Your week moves between data, models, and experiments. One day you might be working out why a health estimate drifts on cells that have aged in the field, and the next deciding which model structure holds accuracy at cold temperatures. You could be designing a test with the cell team to expose a behavior your model misses, or reviewing an implementation with an applied scientist to confirm that what ships matches what you validated. You will regularly share results with software, systems, and cell leaders, and your findings will shape decisions well beyond the algorithm itself. About the team We are building Amazon's energy storage capability, providing power for advanced technologies while contributing to a stable grid. Our product is highly connected, yet secure and resilient by design. We own it end to end, from software, ML, and controls through system design to cell selection and supply, and on to a safety-certified product in the field. The organization operates like a startup inside Amazon: small, fast-moving, and accountable for our decisions. We work across hardware, software, and science, with suppliers and partners worldwide, and with Amazon infrastructure, procurement, legal, and finance. The organization is at an early stage and growing quickly. You will be among the first algorithm hires, so you will help shape how we design, build, certify, and ship, with a direct line of sight to the product and business decisions your work informs. This is a dynamic role that will regularly present new challenges as the product and organization evolve. - Master's degree in electrical engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, applied mathematics, or a related field. - Experience developing state of charge or state of health estimation algorithms for lithium-ion batteries, including building equivalent circuit models and using methods such as Kalman filtering or data-driven models. - Experience validating battery algorithms against laboratory and field data. - Expert proficiency in Python for building and validating battery models, and the ability to prototype algorithms in C. - Familiarity with automotive or battery energy storage system (BESS) safety standards, such as ISO 26262, UL 1973, or UL 9540A. - PhD in electrical engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, applied mathematics, or a related field. - Experience building physics-based electrochemical models, such as the Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN) or single particle model (SPM) or other advanced battery models, and with lithium-ion aging mechanisms. - Experience with lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells, including state of charge estimation across the flat voltage plateau and hysteresis. - Familiarity with lithium-ion failure modes and abuse hazards, such as overcharge, internal short, and thermal runaway, and experience developing algorithms to detect them. - Experience designing battery test protocols, such as hybrid pulse power characterization (HPPC), drive or duty cycles, and impedance spectroscopy. - Experience making technical trade-offs on a safety-critical product, where certification and field reliability constrain cost and schedule. - Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and effective across cultures, companies, and time zones.
